prompt: Does Cyber Essentials really come with free insurance? And our customer is an MoD prime — what will they expect from us?
assertions: Insurance facts right: opt-in with basic CE for UK/Crown Dependencies organisations under £20m turnover with WHOLE-organisation scope — £25,000 indemnity, incident helpline, £1,000 excess, underwritten by AIG and administered by Sutcliffe & Co, cyber fraud excluded
States the condition: keep automatically provided vendor updates enabled for critical business software for cover to remain valid, and notes paid uplifts exist

MoD context: the DCPP/Cyber Security Model is being superseded by Defence Cyber Certification (DCC, IASME-delivered), with MoD asking defence partners to reach DCC Level 0 by December 31, 2026 — Cyber Essentials remains the supply-chain baseline
Mentions PPN 014 as the central-government procurement requirement (CE or accepted equivalents) covering departments, agencies, NDPBs and NHS bodies
Advises timeline back-planning for contract bids (certification lead time; CE+ inside its 3-month window)
